mask: R AO, G smoothness, B metal detail mask, A ceramic detail mask
pivot: the rig deck's centre on the ground, as Cutscene_Drill: swap it in place
bind_pose: the wreck (a static use of the FBX shows the wreck)

Collapse.start: frame 0 = Cutscene_Drill standing with its string sunk (after Sink), glow off
Collapse.end: frame 60.. 84 = the bind pose (the wreck), held

fall.direction: the top lies towards Blender +X turned 22 deg towards +Y (over the motor house); the thrown string lands on -X, the side Gravemaw comes up

emission: dead: no cyan left; dim ember slivers in the torn leg ends and the crushed house (ember orange x0.55; keep Unity's WreckEmission 0.6)
use: ColonyRigView.Smash: show the wreck at the smash frame and play Collapse (role Death) from 0; it ends in the wreck pose and holds it. Dust at impact, sparks at top_hits_ground and house_crushed.
